name: prepare-opens-one-read-only-probe
body: `prepare` now opens a read-only probe of `db.lbug` (`db_has_pending_state`) on every targeted scan whose database exists, in addition to the capture `cmd_scan` takes later. It is one cheap open in a path that already walks the tree and reads the fact store; upgrade to a cheaper pending-state check (or thread the capture's verdict through) only if a scan-time profile ever shows that read-only open dominating.
